jobs.program: 2027 Clerkship Recruitment Program (summer clerkships commencing late 2027)
jobs.notes: Scheme-wide opening is 9:00am AEST on Wednesday 9 June 2027; the scheme sets two alternative closing dates (Sunday 4 July or Sunday 11 July 2027, 11:59pm AEST) and each participating firm chooses one, so a single close date cannot be confirmed — offers can be made from 9:00am 8 September 2027 and must be accepted or declined by 1:00pm 9 September 2027; open to final or penultimate year students.

jobs.jurisdiction: National (Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth, Canberra, Darwin)
jobs.notes: The firm's own early careers page states applications are currently closed and will open in June for the 2027/28 seasonal clerkship program, but no exact 2027 open or close date is published yet (each office follows its state scheme's dates).

The firm's graduate centre page confirms the 2026/2027 clerkship round has closed and that the 2027/2028 program will be advertised in line with the relevant Law Society/Law Institute recruitment guidelines, but no 2027 dates are published yet.
